what: Which real moments the game may serve (Settings → Full highlights rebuild → Real moment highlights). Every fully real open-play shot that passes the automatic checks is in by default; a moment listed here as "dont" is kept out, one listed as "use" is let in even if a check left it out (it must still be a fully real shot of a kind the game serves). Written by the Real moments page's Commit; read data/realmoments/README.md, "Real moments in the game".
